title: 第5章 告诉我什么叫镇北王第6章 你在教本王做事
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
叶凡推开房门。
李幽若一身华丽宫装，又恢复成往日那般，高高在上，眼高于顶，目空一切的大夏长公主！
“镇北王，你怕了？”
李幽若一口一个镇北王，嘲讽意味十足。
叶凡走到她身前！
李幽若依旧仰着高傲的头颅，冰冷的盯着叶凡！
叶凡抬手一巴掌，打的李幽若差点疼哭了，愤怒的回头，恶狠狠的盯着叶凡：“你敢打我？”
“这么震惊干吗？我第一次打你？”叶凡毫不客气。
无视李幽若，看向一旁，一脸佩服的王大年：“你有事禀报？”
一旁伺候的丫鬟们，全都惊呆了！
王大年暗暗竖起大拇指，又犹豫的扫了一眼李幽若，欲言又止。
“说。”
“王爷！昨晚看您睡得香，没敢打扰您！昨夜子时，有一名高手救走了秦风，我们没看住他！”王大年如实禀报。
单膝跪地：“请王爷治罪！”
“真的？哈哈，好，太好了！”李幽若很激动。
叶凡表现的很平静：“一个废人，活着比死了更痛苦。”
“对了，我八姐回来了吗？”
王大年凝重的点头：“已经通知八小姐，她应该昨夜已经启程。”
“不过，北境距离龙都两千里，哪怕是八小姐乘坐最快的闪电隼，恐怕也要中午才能到了。”
听说叶凡的八姐要回来，李幽若脸色大变。

“叶凡！沈慕戎手握北境八十万大军，没有我父皇的命令，不得回龙都！”
“你让她回来干什么？叶凡你疯了吗？”
八姐，沈慕戎。
大夏帝国的镇北大将军，巾帼不让须眉！
……
半个时辰后。
叶凡带着300甲士，直奔皇宫的方向而去。
辇车里，李幽若盯着叶凡的脸，心中暗暗发誓：‘叶凡！今天就是你的死期！只要见到父皇，你绝对死定了！’
‘你殴打我，还要造反的事，我一定如实禀报父皇！’
‘还有风哥！他身为父皇钦点的大夏状元郎，居然被你弄成废人！叶凡，我一定要报此血海深仇！’
一旁的叶凡，闭着眼睛，当然不知道李幽若心里的想法！
他也没兴趣！
此刻，叶凡正在混沌空间内。
content_en:
Ye Fan pushed open the door.
Li Youruo, dressed in gorgeous palace attire, has returned to her former self, the arrogant, arrogant and arrogant eldest princess of Great Xia!
"King Zhenbei, are you afraid?"
Li Youruo talks about Zhenbei King in one mouthful, which is full of irony.
Ye Fan walked up to her!
Li Youruo still raised his proud head and stared at Ye Fan coldly!
Ye Fan raised his hand and slapped Li Youruo, who almost cried in pain. He turned back angrily and stared at Ye Fan fiercely: "You dare to hit me?"
"Why are you so shocked? This is my first time hitting you?" Ye Fan was rude.
Ignoring Li Youruo, he looked aside to Wang Danian with an admiring look on his face: "Do you have something to report?"
The maids waiting on the side were all shocked!
Wang Danian secretly gave a thumbs up, then glanced at Li Youruo hesitantly, but hesitated to speak.
"Say."
"Your Highness! I saw you sleeping soundly last night, so I didn't dare to disturb you! At midnight last night, a master rescued Qin Feng, but we didn't keep an eye on him!" Wang Danian reported truthfully.
Kneeling on one knee: "Please punish me, Your Majesty!"
"Really? Haha, okay, great!" Li Youruo was very excited.
Ye Fan acted very calmly: "A useless person will be more miserable alive than dead."
"By the way, is my eighth sister back?"
Wang Danian nodded solemnly: "Miss Eighth has been notified. She should have set off last night."
"However, the northern border is two thousand miles away from Longdu. Even if Miss Eight takes the fastest Lightning Falcon, it will probably take noon to arrive."
Li Youruo's expression changed drastically when he heard that Ye Fan's eighth sister was coming back.
"Ye Fan! Shen Murong holds 800,000 troops in the north. He cannot return to Longdu without my father's order!"
"Why did you ask her to come back? Mark, are you crazy?"
The eighth sister, Shen Murong.
The great general of Zhenbei of the Great Xia Empire is a woman who cannot be outdone by men!
…
Half an hour later.
Ye Fan took 300 soldiers and went straight to the direction of the palace.
In the carriage, Li Youruo stared at Ye Fan's face and secretly swore in his heart: 'Ye Fan! Today is your death day! As long as you see your father, you will definitely be dead! ’
‘You beat me and rebelled, I will report the truth to my father! ’
‘And Brother Feng! He is the number one scholar in Great Xia appointed by his father, and yet you have turned him into a cripple! Ye Fan, I must avenge this blood feud! ’
Ye Fan on the side had his eyes closed. Of course he didn't know what Li Youruo was thinking!
He's not interested either!
At this moment, Ye Fan is in the chaotic space.
